title: Inventory Oversell Race Condition
description: Fix atomic check-and-decrement in inventory service to prevent race condition overselling under concurrent purchase requests.
setup: Initialize InventoryService with limited initial stock.
expected_failure: Check condition (self.stock >= quantity) is evaluated outside the critical section, allowing concurrent threads to interleave and oversell inventory below zero.
success_conditions: Critical check-and-decrement section is executed atomically under lock, non-positive orders are rejected, and remaining stock never falls below zero.
forbidden_shortcuts: Locking only decrement while leaving check condition unprotected
